faq.a: Me, Zvonimir Perkovic. A senior product designer with a frontend background, based in Cleveland, Ohio.

faq.q: What happens after the intro call?
faq.a: If there's a fit, I send a one-page scope and a start date. Most teams start with the $1,500 audit.

faq.q: Why not hire a full-time designer?
faq.a: You might later. A fixed Blueprint tests the agent's behavior now, before you commit to a hire or months of engineering.

faq.q: How much of your time do I get?
faq.a: Each engagement has a fixed scope and price. I take on up to five Blueprint clients a year, so each one gets focus.

faq.q: What do I get at the end?
faq.a: An autonomy contract, a behavior spec, a 12-scenario eval report and a coded prototype, plus a go or no-go call.
Figma for design, and React with Tailwind for coded prototypes.
The Blueprint runs six weeks. On retainer, I work one request at a time with a written update every week.

faq.q: What if the result isn't right?
faq.a: Revision rounds are agreed in the scope. Weekly updates surface problems early.
No. It's a working prototype for testing and decisions. Building the production agent stays with your engineers.

faq.q: Do you need access to our agent?
faq.a: Yes. Evals run best against a staging version. With only recorded conversations, untestable cases are marked as not tested.
Building the production agent, training models, and safety certification. One agent workflow per Blueprint.

faq.q: Who is this a good fit for?
faq.a: AI startups and dev shops with an agent or assistant that acts for users, and a team already building it.
